motds.body: Welcome back to Springfield! Take care of business at The Confidential, extract the Reload-first John Wick Sprite, and complete the Battle Pass Quest to earn the John Wick (The Simpsons) Outfit.
motds.tabTitle: The Simpsons and John Wick Hit Reload!

motds.body: Extract the adorable and terrible power of the John Wick Sprite, which only spawns in Reload!
motds.title: John Wick Sprite in Reload

motds.body: Geno is causing glitches in Island systems, and it's supercharging the hunt for Sprites! Through August 20, summon Sprites without spending Sprite Dust, level Sprites twice as fast, track down Lucky Locators to help complete the Collection, and different Sprite variants are boosted each day.
motds.title: Stabilize the Zero Point

motds.body: Straight from Queens, Lil Tecca takes over Festival Season 15! Neon Dreams Pass holders get access to the spiked-out Tour Ready Lil Tecca Outfit with a standard and music-reactive Style, a reactive two-handed Pickaxe that fires up, and more. Drop into Festival to make the most of every reward.
motds.title: Neon Dreams Music Pass
